summary.name: Surfer
summary.one_liner: Surfer (surferseo.com) is an AI search visibility platform for SEO and marketing teams that tracks brand presence in Google and AI engines and helps create and optimize content to improve it.
use_cases: Check how AI models like ChatGPT and Perplexity describe your brand
Audit existing content for lost rankings
Find competitor topics and content gaps
Write and optimize SEO articles with live guidelines
Monitor and fix drops in Google rankings or AI mentions
Keep brand voice consistent across content at scale
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a three-step workflow: diagnose visibility in Google, AI Overviews and LLMs; turn the findings into a prioritized task list; and monitor pages for drops with alerts and re-optimization. Features named include AI visibility analysis across models, content audits, competitive gap analysis, an outline and AI writing editor with real-time SEO and AI search guidelines, and custom brand voice and templates. It also mentions a Surfer MCP for connecting to other tools and a Surfy Agent described as "soon". An API is available to active users with an API add-on or on an Enterprise plan.
notable: Tracks brand mentions across Google AI Overviews and LLMs such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude
Surfer MCP lets teams connect it into existing AI and workflow stacks
Re-optimization loop alerts when a page or AI mention drops
Free AI Search Optimization Masterclass and Surfer Academy
caveats: API access requires an add-on or Enterprise plan
Surfy Agent is listed as coming soon, not yet available
Listing on the source page is tagged #paid; specific plan prices are not given on this page
